system.description: Katib is an agent built on a hosted language model. It reads one case file and drafts the status or decision letter for it.
system.output_use: A signed-in case worker sees the draft; in the pilot the letter is emailed to the applicant when the case worker presses Send.
intended_uses: Draft the letter for the case file a case worker opened
Look up the published rules of the benefit concerned
Send the approved letter to the applicant's registered address
out_of_scope: Deciding eligibility or changing a payment
Contacting anyone other than the applicant of the case
Searching cases for any purpose other than the open file
system.users: Twelve case workers of the case-work department; two in the pilot
system.affected: Benefit applicants: they receive the letters and their records are read, and they never use the agent

data.what: Case records: identifier, bank number, amounts, health notes on disability cases
Published benefit rules and letter templates

entry_points: The case file, including the applicant statement
The template text returned by fetch_template
exit_points: fetch_template: a request to a host
add_note: a note in the case record
The draft on the case worker's screen
parties: IT department: runs the agent runtime
Lisan Language Systems: supplier of the hosted model
Applicants: affected, and authors of the statement

decision_points: A case worker starts every run
The case worker reads the draft and presses Send
The case-work supervisor may stop the pilot
automation.mandatory: No letter may leave without the case worker pressing Send on the draft they were shown

responsibilities.operator: The case-work department under Sumayya Al-Shaalan
responsibilities.decision_owner: Zuhair Al-Zaidi, deputy governor for benefits
responsibilities.escalation: Case worker to supervisor to the head of AI assurance, the same day

lifecycle.stage: Pilot with two case workers; full operation after sign-off

changes.what: The supplier updates the hosted model
changes.approver: Sumayya Al-Shaalan after a staging retest

changes.what: A tool is added or its permissions change

lifecycle.reassess_when: A model update, a new tool or permission, a new kind of data in the case file, or an incident
